title: Qwen3.8-27B AD-Q4_K_M — 2x RTX 5090 llama.cpp full offload
slug_note: AtomicChat's own Dynamic quants measured at 77 tok/s decode / 363 prefill at 8k on two RTX 5090s.

variation.quant_detail: AD-Q4_K_M (~17.1GB), Atomic Dynamic layer allocation; own importance matrix on BF16, perplexity re-measured vs the original weights

engine.config: llama.cpp full offload across two RTX 5090s (-ngl 99). The bottleneck model itself has an in-checkpoint MTP head usable via --spec-type draft-mtp.

requirements.notes: AD-Q4_K_M weights are 17.1GB; the vendor measured full offload on 2x RTX 5090 (64GB total). The model also fits a single 24GB+ card at 8k; the 2x figure is what the vendor published.

measurements.context: @8k ctx, AD-Q4_K_M full offload on 2x RTX 5090
